'''Young Jedi''' is Decipher's 1999 ''Star Wars'' customizable card game based on ''The Phantom Menace''. It is a different game from [[Star Wars CCG]]. Decipher held both licenses; designers, Squadron Members, and the player base overlapped.

The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site published two Young Jedi lists next to its Classic Star Wars decks: ''Wizards!'' (Jedi) and ''All Droids All the time!'' (Sith), both as Gold 31 ([[Alex Alcalde]]). Archived copies: [https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/jedi1.html jedi1.html] · [https://web.archive.org/web/20011202101302/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/decks/jedi1.html Wayback, 2 December 2001]; [https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/sith1.html sith1.html] · [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009020148/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/sith1.html Wayback, 9 October 2026].
